description: Hexloghogs on Earth, Moon, and Mars using entry philosophy of CHNOPS and LifeCRN as focus.
summary: A simple 9 Hex board game and philosophy stone foundry for a renewal of awe and wonder about the chemistry and life origins of early earth and beyond. Built with Claude.
details:
This project is intended to be utilized as a foundational game set for establishing new and unique value missions as they relate to the exploration and research of early life.

It uses CHNOPS as an introduction device to ongoing and evolving analog missions. The project as presented is an ideation for super wicked intel as feedback loop/troubleshoot. It is necessary in the next steps of this project to match H3 locations on 9 Hex locations to NASA and USGS data sets. In addition to resources from this hackathon, the Nasaorbit and Moon Challenge opportunities will expand the scale and capability of this game design.
